prior.summary: New to this reviewed candidate catalogue and mechanism contrast; MC2023 prediction is prior, not first discovery.
prior.case_context: Published DFT studies of LiPtH3/NaPtH3 hydrogen storage and metallic/mechanical/phonon properties are acknowledged. A 2026-10-07 exact-phase search found no experimental superconducting LiPtH3 benchmark. Novelty is the bounded matched Li-for-Na pairing-construction hypothesis in the reviewed catalogue, not first synthesis/composition.

sources.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds
Primary source study: conventional superconducting compounds

prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: Hydrogen desorption, zero-point/anharmonic response and decomposition compete with superconductivity. The exact source path is nonnegative and Gamma optical compression positive; force is zero by symmetry but fine pressure remains 0.288 GPa. The retained LaPtH3 control has larger lambda but lower separate Eli Tc, showing an omega/coupling tradeoff; AgPtH3 and LiPdH3 have still larger lambda with actual negative source paths, so they are not silently discarded or treated as stable superior cases.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Both source SCFs converge, near-zero coarse forces/stress and bounded fine response are measured. Fine Fmax=0 eV/A, P=0.288 GPa, full max stress=0.288 GPa. Gamma optical compression is positive beyond printing bound and sampled path has no signed negative values. All listed q outputs have JOBDONE/last response convergence and no routine errors. This supports a finite-grid local/metastable source model, not global hull or experimental synthesis.

proposed_contribution.intervention: Li replaces Na on the alkali site with the Pt-H network and ordered sites retained. Source cell volume decreases 7.661%, changing the actual Pt-H/H-H distances. All ten lambda values and the independent Eli mu=.1 result improve versus NaPtH3. This is a coupled cation/bond-network construction, not an inferred mobile-carrier density or volume-only mechanism.
proposed_contribution.next_action: Use the frozen Li/Na roles to compare at common volume and common sampling, retaining lambda and omega separately, then address H loss or anharmonicity. Stable positive paired response supports the stated source domain; desorption/decomposition or disappearance under common method reverses it.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
